name: test_average_monthly_sales_requires_at_least_one_month
description:
Objective: Average monthly sales requires at least one month.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import the production-support rule or page-object contract exercised by tests/unit/calculator/test_calculator_prd_oracle.py.
3. Create only the isolated fixture/state encoded in the authoritative test definition; do not substitute customer data.
4. Execute `test_average_monthly_sales_requires_at_least_one_month` exactly as defined in tests/unit/calculator/test_calculator_prd_oracle.py:87.
5. Evaluate the deterministic assertion(s): `pytest.raises(ValueError, match='At least one statement month')`.
6. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: Average monthly sales requires at least one month.
2. The authoritative deterministic expression(s) evaluate as encoded: `pytest.raises(ValueError, match='At least one statement month')`.
3. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
